up: List all distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5726716. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). The document is stored in the docs table; link through compound_records (docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id) to molecule_dictionary (compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno). Optionally join with compound_structures (molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno) for SMILES. Do not apply any extra filters or limits.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       md.pref_name,
       cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726716';
